repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an unnecessary absolute-value correction for negative differences (lines 5-7) which alters the IR's arithmetic logic. F2 shows the candidate acted when the IR did not, implying the condition evaluation was incorrect due to this modification. F3 confirms the IR specifies a direct signed subtraction ($t2 - $t1) without any conditional negation.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the conditional absolute-value logic that modified the difference calculation. The script now strictly follows the IR's requirement to evaluate the signed difference $t2 - $t1 directly.
